---
title: "Process and Analyze Qualitative Data"
subtitle: "v2 (2026-11-21)"
output:
  pdf_document: default
classoption: landscape
---

```{r setup, include = F}
# Import =======================================================================
library(here)
library(openxlsx)
library(srvyr)
library(tidyverse)

casper_qual <- readRDS(here("data/casper_kauai26_recovery_data_clean.rds")) %>%
  select(starts_with("surv_")) %>%
  left_join(
    readRDS(here("data/casper_kauai26_recovery_data_clean_wqual.rds")),
    by = join_by(surv_id)
  )

qual_surv <- as_survey_design(casper_qual,
                              ids = surv_cluster,
                              weights = surv_weight)

# Worker Functions =============================================================
# Function for getting summaries of factors ------------------------------------
# NOTE: Can only accept 1 variable at a time
summarize_factor <- function(var_name) {
  
  # TODO: Consider keeping NA's, why are we removing?
  #  - How does it handle places where the data are skipped?
  #  - Want to show % of people where whole is number that saw the question
  a <- qual_surv %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]))
  
  # Break if all data are NA
  if (nrow(a)==0){
    warning("No non-missing observations for ", var_name)
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Make sure this variable is a factor
  if (!is.factor(pull(a, var_name))) {
    a <- a %>%
      mutate(across(all_of(var_name), as.factor))
  }
  
  # Get factor levels for later joining
  level_df <- data.frame(
    Category = levels(pull(a, var_name))
  )
  level_df$Variable <- var_name
  
  a %>%
    # grouping by values in each variable
    group_by(.data[[var_name]]) %>%
    summarize(
      # count of responses for each variable
      Frequency = n(),
      Estimated_HH = round(survey_total(vartype = "var"), 0),
      # Calculates the weighted percentage of the population that falls into this category
      # The vartype = "ci" tells R to automatically calculate the 95% CIs
      Percent = round(
        survey_prop(vartype = c("ci", "se"), 
                    prop_method = "likelihood",
                    proportion = TRUE
                    ) * 100, 
        2)) %>%
    # lists var_names in a column called category
    mutate(Variable = var_name, Category = .data[[var_name]]) %>%
    # Bring in factor levels that may have been blank
    full_join(level_df, by = c("Variable", "Category")) %>%
    mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = level_df$Category)) %>%
    arrange(Category) %>%
    # Only keep wanted cols
    select(Question = Variable,
           Answer = Category,
           N = Frequency,
           `Est HH`=Estimated_HH,
           Pct=Percent,
           `Pct 95CI L` = Percent_low,
           `Pct 95CI U` = Percent_upp,
           `Pct SE` = Percent_se)
}
```

# Changes to Plans for Future Storms

**After the hurricane, are there any changes your HH will make to your emergency preparedness plans or supplies to be more prepared for future storms?**

Yes respondents only, manually coded, up to 3 options.

```{r q11, echo = F}
post_hurr_changes <- names(casper_qual)[startsWith(names(casper_qual), "supp_post_hurr_ch_")]

post_hurr_changes_table <- map(post_hurr_changes, summarize_factor) %>%
  list_rbind()
knitr::kable(post_hurr_changes_table)
```

# Information without Radio

**After the hurricane, our island's two emergency radio stations, KKCR and Kong, were down in many areas. Where did your HH go for information during this time?**

Manually coded, single code.

```{r q19, echo = F}
info_wo_radio <- names(casper_qual)[startsWith(names(casper_qual), "imp_info_no_radio_")]

info_wo_radio_table <- summarize_factor(info_wo_radio)
knitr::kable(info_wo_radio_table)
```

# Most Important Government Focus

**What is the most important issue you think government agencies should focus on for continued recovery of our island?**

Manually coded, single code.

```{r q23, echo = F}
govt_focus <- names(casper_qual)[startsWith(names(casper_qual), "imp_govt_focus_")]

govt_focus_table <- summarize_factor(govt_focus)
knitr::kable(govt_focus_table)
```

```{r export, include = F}
all_qual_data <- bind_rows(
  post_hurr_changes_table,
  info_wo_radio_table,
  govt_focus_table
)

saveRDS(all_qual_data, here("data/qual_table.rds"))

write.xlsx(
  list(
    `Q11 Changes` = post_hurr_changes_table,
    `Q19 Info Sources` = info_wo_radio_table,
    `Q23 Govt Focus` = govt_focus_table
  ),
  here("data/Kauai26R Qual Data Tables.xlsx")
)
```
